payload.summary: Additional physical Win7 evidence: entering/configuring Diagnostics far enough to add the token is possible, but attempting to send logs crashes the application. Combined with Assistente entry, Models submenu, voice download, and probes 1/2 crashes, failures span multiple unrelated feature domains and occur when service/network/runtime-backed operations start.
decisions: Add Diagnostics log upload to the shared-crash correlation set.
Do not assume the root cause is model-specific, voice-specific, or Assistente-specific.
Prioritize the earliest common service/network/plugin/native layer invoked by model/update, voice download, Diagnostics upload, and Assistente initialization.
Preserve separate Win7 evidence gate and do not merge from CI alone.
evidence_refs: physical:Win7 build #1175 Diagnostics token can be entered
physical:Win7 build #1175 sending Diagnostics logs crashes
payload.next_action: Correlate Diagnostics upload with Models/update, voice download and Assistente code paths; isolate their earliest shared network/plugin/native dependency before changing production behavior.
